title: Market opportunities
description: Players whose role fit, age, playing time and market position may merit attention. Set the criteria; the screen shows why each player appeared.

error.title: Could not load opportunities
error.description: The API did not respond. Check that the backend is running.

criteria.heading: Criteria
criteria.minRoleFitHint: The weighted composite behind a player's best role, 0–100. Not the role fit percentile — a raw 80 is a high score on its own terms, whatever the population.
criteria.minimumMinutesTooltipLabel: Does this exclude players by default?
criteria.minimumMinutesTooltip: Optional filter. All players are eligible by default regardless of minutes played — this sets a floor only if you want one, and it is empty unless you fill it in.

results.marketValueNote: Market value {value} — a crowd-sourced estimate, not an asking price.
results.emptyDescription: Try lowering the minimum role fit, raising the age limit, or widening the market value ceiling.
